nodes.description: Public address state variable holding the contract owner, initialized to 0x10B16eEDe03cF73CbF44e4BFFFa3e6BFf36F1Fad and used as the only access-control authority.
Public string state variable storing the IPFS metadata URI, mutable only through setIPFSLocation.
Public uint state variable holding the launch timestamp, mutable only through setLaunchDate.
Payable constructor that mints the genesis token 0 to the hardcoded owner address.
View override returning ipfsLocation; requires _tokenId == 0 so only token 0 has metadata.
Only-owner function that overwrites ipfsLocation with a caller-supplied string.
Only-owner function that overwrites launchDate with a caller-supplied value.
Modifier enforcing require(owner == msg.sender) before executing the guarded function body.
msg.sender used inside onlyOwner as the caller identity checked against the owner state variable.
require(owner == msg.sender) access-control gate; relies on a plain address comparison with no zero-address or role abstraction.
State write ipfsLocation = _ipfsLocation performed in setIPFSLocation after the onlyOwner gate.
State write launchDate = _launchDate performed in setLaunchDate after the onlyOwner gate.
Caller-supplied string parameter of setIPFSLocation, written directly into ipfsLocation.
Caller-supplied uint parameter of setLaunchDate, written directly into launchDate.
Token id parameter of tokenURI, required to equal 0.
Local string returned by _baseURI inside ERC721.tokenURI, compared for length before URI composition.

edges.reason: Untrusted msg.sender flows into the require(owner == msg.sender) ownership comparison that gates privileged state writes.
The onlyOwner check must pass before setIPFSLocation executes, so control over the privileged path depends on the caller identity.
The onlyOwner check must pass before setLaunchDate executes, so control over the privileged path depends on the caller identity.
Untrusted string argument _ipfsLocation is written verbatim into the contract state via ipfsLocation = _ipfsLocation.
Untrusted uint argument _launchDate is written verbatim into the contract state via launchDate = _launchDate.
setIPFSLocation assignment mutates the ipfsLocation state variable.
setLaunchDate assignment mutates the launchDate state variable.
tokenURI reads its _tokenId parameter in the require(_tokenId == 0) guard.
The base URI local variable feeds the conditional assembly of the tokenURI return value.
Constructor initializes the owner state variable with the hardcoded privileged address used by every onlyOwner gate.

normalization_plan.reason: The setIPFSLocation parameter is only meaningful as the input to that function and should be folded into the function node.
The setLaunchDate parameter is only meaningful as the input to that function and should be folded into the function node.
The tokenURI parameter is a local read-only guard value that should be folded into the tokenURI function node.
The base URI local is a temporary computed inside tokenURI and should be merged into tokenURI rather than tracked separately.
